text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Normally held at Hanshin,this race comes to you specially
from Kyoto this year—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Once again, the heavyweights are out in full force!
We can expect an intense, fierce race!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Drawing the most attention are Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan, both bearing the proud Mejiro name!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Will one of the two conquer the race!?
Or will someone else—!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible,
it's even more lively than the Kikuka Sho.
choice_data_list: Let's stay calm and composed again this time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Remembering everything
I've shared with Trainer up until now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall remain composed and ensure
I claim this victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Ryan... It seems this is yet another match between us.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (However, I still have no intention of surrendering victory today.)
